history.notes: Data: Solada public JSON endpoints https://www.solada.fun/api/launches (111 launches) and /api/market (90 quotes; USD mcap, 24h vol, trades, holders, createdAt, pump progress). Site HTML is JS-rendered, API was public and readable. Rates: CoinGecko ADA=0.23112 USD / 0.32786 CAD (implied USD->CAD 1.4186) at ~16:50 ET 2026-10-15. Ages from createdAt vs run time. X: search_posts_all for 'solada', candidate tickers + soladafun since Oct 13. Lots of 'solada' noise is Portuguese football slang; DM-solicitation spam (@iSolCryptoo, @Theana174, @realmarc9, @Monerocrypto_, @JouriAlia, @SolanaGurupnl) replies to @DustBunnyada - ignored. Biggest real Cardano voices on Solada: @cryptodramz (26k; '1M ADA volume in four days', BOLT graduation), @angrycryptoshow (19.9k; YT highlight), @Fidgetybeast (9.4k), @gr0selhas (3.1k; $SOLADA #2 mcap on snek.fun). Platform token $SOLADA itself ~1.15M ADA mcap per @CardanoSmartAI bot, ~323 holders. Risk: custodial platform - Solada holds dev portions/bridged supply and settles ADA<->Solana via its own operator (API exposes operator/cold-sweep/recovery endpoints); counterparty and withdrawal risk on every coin. Most launches have <30 holders and volume multiples of mcap = churn. Skipped: BEAST (36h, ~17.7k ADA mcap, vol 4x mcap, 63 holders, -21%): Pass. PCOCK, BABYBOLT, VOLT, DBUN, MILK and other <2h launches: Pass/pure lottery (<30 holders, copycats). CORE (mascot, 142h, ~61.9k ADA mcap, 99 holders, -21%): Pass, stale. Research alert only, not financial advice.
